title: drain_once Err(e) logging does not include the error message inline
description: The new warn\! in the drain_once Err arm (line 356-358) reads: warn\!(dir=..., "relay queue: failed to read dead/ dir for metrics: {e}"). This is correct and adds the missing diagnostic from round-5. However the log message says 'for metrics' — an operator seeing this at 2am will not know whether this is a harmless metrics gap or a sign the dead/ directory itself is corrupted/missing. The message should indicate that delivery is unaffected and only the metric count is unknown.
